G1 hadley_jet (675/4748 looser): fix 10.6/10.7 generalization; (3) 10.5 'stays within' wording; (4) rho_F<=rho_G is N, not open.

findings.claim: THEORY 10.3(b) reports 'the solves have backward error at most 1.4e-15' without the tested range, and DERIVATION S6 says 'The pivot bound of T2(b) controls growth in the complex sweep'.
findings.evidence: The bounds Re p_r >= z - lambda_max(Ht_m) and |l_r| <= |B_m[r][r-1]|/(z - mu_A) hold in every case checked. However, the multiplier bound grows like 1/(z - mu_A). For centred divergent flow at meridional Pe 1e3-1e5, or kappa=0, with z - mu_A in 1e-12..1e-6 of the scale, the no-pivot sweep reaches growth up to 1e8, multipliers up to 3e3, and backward error 1e-11 to 5.5e-6 (e.g. 6x10 kappa=0 hadley: 5.5e-6; 32x64 alt_merid Pe 1e5: 1.1e-9). LAPACK with partial pivoting gives 4e-17 on the same systems; upwind stays <= 2e-16. At the builder's settings (z >= mu_A + 1e-4 scale, Pe <= 30) the error is <= 1e-15. Evidence: scratchpad review_KS-N8/out/thomas_near.json and validity.jsonl.
findings.correction: In 10.3(b), state the tested range: z - mu_A >= 1e-4 of the scale and cell Pe <= 30. In DERIVATION S6, replace 'controls growth' with: growth is bounded only while z - mu_A is not small relative to |B_m[r][r-1]|. Also record that the P solver needs pivoting or a refusal margin for centred divergent flow at high Péclet near the threshold.

findings.claim: 10.6: 'The 9 looser cases are all upwind Hadley-plus-jet flow at Péclet 30'. 10.7: 'For divergent upwind flow at high Péclet, the Gershgorin radius remains the tighter spectral radius'. The zonal table row: 'rho_F equals the spectral radius to within 2.2e-4'.
findings.evidence: These are artifacts of sampling Pe only at {0.3, 30}. On the builder's own G1 grid and its hadley_jet family at cell Pe 1, the centred radius is looser: rho_F/rho_G = 1.00081, confirmed by a lower bound of the true numerical radius. G2 and G3 show 1.00013 and 1.00017 (uniform_merid, polar_face). At Pe = 1 a centred meridional off-diagonal vanishes, the block becomes locally triangular and Gershgorin is exact for the spectrum. Over 4748 cases, 74/1480 centred divergent cases are looser (up to 1.054). Upwind divergent cases are looser in 601/1480, not always (random_both upwind 39/148); the maximum is 1.2071 = (1+sqrt2)/2, a Jordan-type 2x2 limit. Zonal flows are never looser. Zonal rho_F/rho_true - 1 reaches 4.9% on 2x4 and 3x5 grids and 7.1e-4 on G1-G3.
findings.correction: Rephrase: rho_F <= rho_G fails for divergent flow under both schemes, centred near cell Pe 1 and upwind at high Pe in many families. Mark the 2.2e-4 zonal figure as specific to the tested set. The D2 FAIL verdict is unchanged.

findings.claim: 10.5: '||R(hJ)||_A stays within 1.6e-13 (relative) of the bound ... ||e^{tJ}||_A stays within 1.1e-14 of its bound'.
findings.evidence: A7 and A8 record max(norm/bound - 1), which is a one-sided excess. In KS_N8_FOV.json the per-case maxima for divergent flows are -1.9e-7..-1.6e-13 (RODAS5P) and -1.8e-6..-1.7e-12 (exp). The norms therefore sit below their bounds, not within 1.6e-13 of them.
findings.correction: Write 'never exceeds the bound by more than 1.6e-13 (relative) / 1.1e-14'.

findings.claim: 10.7 lists 'rho_F <= rho_G in general (false in 9 measured cases)' under 'UNVERIFIED or open'.
findings.evidence: Counterexamples exist: 9 in the builder's run and 687 in the reviewer's runs, all confirmed against the true numerical range. That makes it a negative result, not an open question.
findings.correction: List it as N (negative result) with the counterexample families.
